analysis: The code snippet is inside the method fireVideoEvent, which synchronizes on the videoListeners object before calling videoListeners.toArray(new VideoListener[videoListeners.size()]). The videoListeners is a collection of VideoListener objects. The array argument is a newly created VideoListener array of the same size as the list, so it is non-null. The elements in the list are of type VideoListener or its subclasses, so the array type is a supertype of all elements. Therefore, both declared exceptions are avoided in this context.
remark: No exceptions are thrown because the array argument is non-null (new VideoListener[...]) and its runtime type is a supertype of all elements in the list (VideoListener). Thus, neither NullPointerException nor ArrayStoreException can occur.
